name: Leyla and Mecnun
s: Leyla ile Mecnun is a Turkish television comedy series. The show is set in Istanbul, Turkey. The series is a surreal and absurd comedy that revolves around the fictional love story between Layla and Majnun.

paragraphs.text: Leyla ile Mecnun (Leyla and Mecnun) is a Turkish television comedy series. The series, set in Istanbul and directed by Onur Ünlü, premiered in 2011 on TRT. It is a surreal, absurdist comedy revolving around the parody of the poetic love story of Layla and Majnun. It released seasons 1-3 on TRT1 between 2011 and 2013, then seasons 4-7 on the streaming platform Exxen between 2021 and 2023.
